lines.text: Balak meets Balaam at the Moabite city on the Arnon border, and Balaam says he must speak only God's word.
Balak takes Balaam up to Bamoth-baal, where they offer a bull and a ram on each of seven altars.
In his first oracle, Balaam says Balak brought him from Edom to curse Israel, but he asks how he can curse those God has not cursed.
Balak takes Balaam to the top of Hermon, and Balaam's second oracle says God is not a man that He should lie.
Balak takes Balaam to the top of Peor, and Balak offers a bull and a ram on each of seven altars.
